description: Asked whether he had been the lover, and left the horn.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Priced the board and the loaf, and refused the letter as tonight's work.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Said a letter should wait for the age it is meant for.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Ate, named the part, and left the letter unwritten.
name: William Shakespeare
